text:
maria: Observed sustained p99 egress jitter on rack-31 tied to two tenants. Suspect NIC tx queue hogging.
sam: Any packet drops? or just long tx stall times? :thinking_face:
dmitri: Low drops, high tx_stall_time and KV eviction spikes. Tenants: tenant-luna (many small syncs) + tenant-sigma (wide embedding scatter).
maria: Quick mitigation idea: test NIC queue shaping on a canary rack for 1h and use proxy token-buckets as fallback. If shaping fails, carve a temporary dedicated slice and steer tenants.
sam: Agree. Can we canary shaping without traffic teardown? We should simulate load with the traffic-replay tool on canary.
dmitri: Plan: 1) spin canary rack shaping profile (5m deploy), 2) replay a sampled subset of tenant load (non-prod) for 15m, 3) measure tail latency and tx_stall_time. If p99 drops >= 30% we promote to production. Else proceed to slice carveout.
infra-bot: Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/nic-shaping. Telemetry query: https://telemetry.redwood.internal/egress?rack=31
sam: Cost note for slice (if needed): ~€50/hr p4d-1x equiv. Finance ticket required if >2h.
maria: I'll kick off canary shaping now and post results. Keeping this thread for decisions only.
